notes.title: College Kings 2 Episode 6 “Summer Showdown” is finally here!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]I know it’s taken a little extra time and I’m so thankful to everyone for being so patient. I’m happy to say that [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3126690/College_Kings_2__Episode_6_Summer_Showdown/" style="button"]Episode 6[/url] is finally here![/p][previewyoutube="xfwtF3hhx1k;full"][/previewyoutube][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39149528/1767e819694bffb539955257632c80bd9037af1c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Episode 6 "Summer Showdown"[/h3][p]The Summer Showdown begins… step into the ring and let the battle commence. Unleash the warrior within and take the gold, solidifying your rep as the one true College King! [/p][p]Of course, it’s not just about the fight. There’s plenty of new adventures to get excited about in this episode as the gang heads south of the border to check out the party scene in Mexico where there’ll be booze, bikinis and… Ancient Aztec Temples? [/p][p]You’ll also get to explore Nerd-Con, the biggest pop culture convention in San Vallejo! Play your cards right and you might even create your own crossover between the sheets with some sexy cosplayer babes.[/p][p]The decisions you’ve made across your time in CK2 will decide who, if anyone, is by your side when it all comes to an end at the Summer Showdown, whether it’s in victory or defeat. Whether you’ve been keeping things casual or locked down the girl of your dreams, your choices across the episodes will pay off here![/p][p][/p][h3]College Kings 3[/h3][p]College Kings 2 has been an amazing experience for the team and I, it’s had its ups and downs, and I’ve definitely learned a lot! I’m excited to apply what I’ve learned to College Kings 3. More information to come on what’s next for us very soon, but for now I’m happy to say that the store page for [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3740020/College_Kings_3/" style="button"]College Kings 3[/url] is live now and you can [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3740020/College_Kings_3/"]wishlist it here[/url]![/p][p]Thank you all for making this possible![/p][p][/p][p]Much love, [/p][p]Steve[/p]

notes.title: College Kings 2 Episode 4: "Moving Out" is coming in Spring 2024.
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we’re happy to finally announce that the sequel to College Kings (College Kings 2) is launching Episode 4: Moving Out, in the Spring of next year (2024)! 

As the New Year dawns, our beloved friends at San Vallejo College face unprecedented challenges. The Apes and Wolves are in disarray, their frat houses are under threat, and leadership is in short supply.

With the fraternities' futures at stake, your decisions have never been more crucial. Step up to resolve the leadership dilemmas emerging from the fighting tournament (or don’t!), intense rivalries are beginning to emerge that could call your alliances and friendships into question, and of course, plenty of intense sex scenes for you to enjoy, whether it’s passionate and intimate lovemaking session in your girlfriend’s bed or a sloppy blowjob in the back of a car you’re looking for, we’ve got you covered.

Immerse yourself in the classic College Kings experience: college fist-fights, unforgettable parties, and intimate moments with your favorite girls. The steamy animated scenes are the best they’ve ever been, with top-tier image and animation quality, and more than 30 hand-crafted sultry sex animations to discover.

Prepare to navigate this new chapter in the College Kings saga. With Chris and Grayson out of the picture, will you be able to seize the crown and rule SVC? And if you are, what will your favorite girls think of your decision? Mark your calendars for Spring 2024 and get ready to move out into a world of excitement, drama, and romance! Wishlist now to stay up to date and play it the second we release it!

notes.title: College Kings - The Complete Season
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39149528/e125c60b5bd165074c4e908877aa9d87a371d780.png[/img]

[u][h2]COLLEGE KINGS - THE COMPLETE SEASON[/h2][/u]
We’re excited to announce that College Kings Act I, Act II and Act III, which is split across three Steam stores and game downloads, has now been combined into one Steam store; one single game download; and is free to play for a better gaming experience.

[b][h3]DETECTIVE AMBER & HER DEDICATED SIDEKICK[/h3][/b]
The administration is scrutinising the Chicks, Apes, and Wolves, and while things have settled down at the Chicks after their presidential election, everyone’s nervous about what’s going on behind the scenes. notes.title: Announcing College Kings 2!
notes.content:
When College Kings started as a bedroom project just 18 months ago, we never imagined the huge amount of popularity it would gain. We didn’t intend to do more than 3 acts, but with such an incredible community, there is simply no way we’re stopping now.

Since our humble beginnings, we have grown to become a studio of award-winning writers, accomplished artists and brilliant coders. With our team constantly raising the bar for what it means to be an Adult Visual Novel, [b]we believe it’s time for a new beginning.[/b]

College Kings has never been more exciting. Welcome to the new era of stunning visuals, immersive sex scenes and a vast branching narrative where every choice matters.

[b]College Kings 2 Act I will replace what used to be Act IV[/b], with the story continuing right where Act III left off. But don’t worry, your decisions and relationships from the first game carry over.

notes.title: College Kings v0.6 Release & Steam Achievements
notes.content:
The 0.6 update is here! This update adds almost an hour of new story, developing character paths and giving you more pathing than ever before. 

[b]Due to significant changes in code, saves from previous versions will not work. This is a one time occurrence and your saves will be compatible with future updates. We apologize for the inconvenience.[/b]

CHANGELOG V0.6

New content:
* 1200+ New Renders
* 20+ New Animations
* 3 Dates
* 2 Sex Scenes
* Wolves Rush Party
* Lots of main & side story progression

Gameplay:
* Even more pathing, making your choices matter more than ever before
* Added new achievements
* Added new scenes to scene selector
* New phone messages now rise to the top of contacts
* Steam Achievements support now added!

General Improvements:
* Changed a lot of the code, including revamping the entire phone code to enable a better foundation for the future

Bug Fixes:
* Fixed spelling & grammar errors from previous versions
* Fixed a lot of bugs
